constraints: Preserve how colored or interactive output is chosen when stdout or stderr is not a terminal.

steps.instructions: Replace `atty::is(Stream::Stdout)` with `std::io::stdout().is_terminal()` (stable since Rust 1.70, `use std::io::IsTerminal`), or use the is-terminal crate on older compilers, and remove the atty dependency.
steps.title: Use std::io::IsTerminal

verification.purpose: Build and test after removing atty.

rule.replacement: std::io::IsTerminal (stable since Rust 1.70), or the is-terminal crate for older compilers
rule.summary: The maintainer of atty has published an official notice that the crate is no longer under development and that users should rely on the standard library's IsTerminal trait.
rule.title: atty is no longer maintained
